profile.summary: Suumaya Industries Limited manufactures, distributes, and retails garments and fabrics. The company operates through three segments: Textile, Retail, and Agri produce. The Textile segment manufactures and retails apparels, PPE kits, and other covid essentials, as well as trades in fabric, yarn, and other textile commodities.
